$comment: Store listing configuration (REQ-MOB-011). The listing text lives in locales/<locale>/store.json; `pnpm tokens:sync` renders both into apps/ios/fastlane/metadata and apps/android/fastlane/metadata/android. A fork replaces the tran.example addresses (a reserved placeholder domain) and maps each new locale here, or skips a store with {"skip": "<why>"}.
appReviewNotes:
No account or password is needed: choose a role on the first screen (Citizen Voter or Election Auditor) to sign in.

Account deletion (guideline 5.1.1(v)): once signed in, choose "Delete account", next to "Sign out", and confirm. The same steps are published at {accountDeletionUrl}.

The eligibility check can run on the device with no network connection, or on the server.

appStore.skip: App Store Connect has no Nepali metadata language (Apple's locale shortcode list, checked 2026-11-10); the App Store shows the en-US listing in Nepal. The app itself still ships Nepali.
